description:
Saalex  is seeking a  Software Engineer (Range Systems) in  Corona, CA.  Saalex is an Engineering and Information Technology Services company with a focus on Test Range Operations and Management, Engineering and Logistics Services, Data Analytics and Business Intelligence Services and Information Technology Services.
 Position Type: Full-Time
 Salary: $115K-$150K (depending on experience) 
 Work Location: Hybrid remote/in-office (see onsite requirements below). Preference for candidates near Corona, CA.
 **On-site Requirements: This position is 25% telework and 75% onsite at NSWC Corona to integrate with hardware. 
 
 Job Summary: 
 Saalex is seeking an experienced Software Engineer to support the development, integration, and sustainment of complex defense-related systems. This role requires collaboration with both software and hardware engineering teams and will contribute to system-level design, implementation, integration, and verification activities. While the role may be performed remotely, periodic on-site support in Corona, CA is required to support hardware and system integration efforts. 
 
 Essential Functions: 
 Design, develop, integrate, and maintain software solutions for complex systems
 Participate in system architecture, requirements analysis, and interface definition
 Develop software that interfaces with hardware components and test equipment
 Support system integration, testing, and validation activities
 Troubleshoot software and hardware integration issues
 Produce and maintain technical documentation
 Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams
 Requirements 
 Required: 
 Minimum of 7 years of relevant systems and/or software engineering experience
 Experience developing software for complex, integrated systems
 Proficiency in C++, Java, Python, or C#
 Experience with hardware/software integration
 Desired: 
 Experience supporting DoD or defense programs
 Familiarity with embedded or real-time systems
 Experience with MBSE or lab-based integration and testing- Experience with remote range systems, scoring systems, and hardware integration.
 Knowledge of TCP/IP, sockets, and client/server architectures.
 
 Education: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. 
 
 Security Clearance: 
 Active Secret Clearance required. Requirements to obtain clearance include US Citizenship, security investigation, etc.
 
 Benefits 
 Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
 Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
 Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
 Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays)
 Short Term & Long Term Disability
 Training & Development
 Wellness Resources
 Stock Option Plan
